title: Orksymbols
description: Adds a lot of Orcy stuff to the game (Fan-art for Crocodileandy)
body:
Changes some textures to the orc emoji from the Discord Server of the german youtuber Crocodileandy.

In the newest Version, it changes:
- the effect icons
- some particles
- Experience clumps
- Enchantment Table
- Smithing Table
- Dragon Egg
- Wheat
- Destroy animation

& much more :)

Still WIP! Updates coming soon
